subject: ISV staging access + SDK gating checklist
messages:
From: Claire Dobson <claire@cobalttech.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Partner Ops <partner-ops@cobalttech.io>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: staging SDK gating checklist and temporary feature flag window

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Cobalt Tech is keen to adopt Redwood for inference in our SaaS platform. Before we start integrating the latest SDK changes, we need a short, actionable gating checklist for the staging environment so our engineering and security teams can sign off.

Specifically we need:
- Precise list of breaking API changes (endpoints + contract diff) since v2.1.
- Expected semver/compatibility policy and a recommended adaptation path.
- Guidance for toggling new SDK behavior (feature flag name + default).
- ETA for the deprecation window and whether you support automatic fallback to legacy endpoints.
- Any required staging IAM roles + sample terraform for access.

We have a security review scheduled for 23 May and would like staging access and the checklist at least 48h prior. Attached is a short change-log we maintain.

Thanks,
Claire
Lead Integrations Engineer
Cobalt Tech

---
Attachment: isv-sdk-change-log.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Claire Dobson <claire@cobalttech.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: staging SDK gating checklist and temporary feature flag window

Claire —

Appreciate the clarity. I pulled together a concise gating checklist below and requested staging credentials from infra. We can provide the full machine-readable contract diff and a migration guide by EOD Monday. High-level answers below:

Gating checklist (staging):
1) API contract diff: attached plain list + patch notes (we will upload machine diff to the drive).
2) Semver policy: major = breaking contract changes; minor = additive + opt-in flags; patch = bugfix. For this change set we are releasing v3.0 (major) with optional compatibility shims for 90 days.
3) Feature flag: redwood.isv.v3_opt_in — default: false in existing SDKs; can be flipped per-client via tenant config.
4) Deprecation window: 90 days from GA for legacy endpoints; automatic fallback: supported via our routing shim for the first 30 days, then explicit fallback must be implemented in the client.
5) Staging IAM: we will create an ephemeral role redwood-isv-staging/<cobalt-team> with a least-privilege policy. Terraform snippet: https://drive.redwood/internal/infra/isv-staging-terraform (will share).
6) Test matrix: unit + integration + golden-response assertion + latency SLO smoke tests — we will provide a runnable test harness.
7) Telemetry/trace: sample span names and logs flagged for partner integration testing.

Requested deliverables we will send by EOD Monday:
- Machine-readable OpenAPI diff and JSON patch.
- Migration guide with code snippets for Node/Python/Java.
- Staging role terraform and one-click setup script.
- Short video walkthrough of the feature flag flip.

Action items for Cobalt Tech:
- Confirm contact for staging IAM (email for terraform binding).
- Run our smoke harness and send any failing golden assertions to infra-qa@redwood.com.

I am looping in Vanessa and Marcus for the staging provisioning and compatibility shims.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Partner Integrations Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Claire Dobson <claire@cobalttech.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: staging SDK gating checklist and temporary feature flag window

Claire / team —

Infra has started provisioning the role and I created the initial terraform snippet in the internal drive. Couple of clarifying points from an engineering operations perspective:
- The routing shim will be deployed as a canary for the first 30 days in eu-west-1 only. If you require other regions we can plan a staggered roll-out but that adds 48–72h of ops lead time.
- For the compatibility shim we’ll ship a lightweight proxy (container) you can run in staging; it will perform header-based routing and token translation. We recommend running the proxy for 2 weeks in your staging to capture edge-cases before toggling redwood.isv.v3_opt_in for traffic.
- Can we get an example repo/branch where Cobalt will run the SDK changes so we can add CI hooks? A GitHub link or ephemeral access token is ideal.

Attachments: staging-access-instructions.pdf (contains step-by-step IAM, token exchange, and sample terraform).

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Engineering Manager, Partner Platform
Redwood Inference

---
From: Claire Dobson <claire@cobalttech.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Partner Ops <partner-ops@cobalttech.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: staging SDK gating checklist and temporary feature flag window

Thanks Olga & Vanessa — this is exactly what we needed.

Quick updates from our side:
- Staging contact: jia.chen@cobalttech.io (will grant repo access).
- We will run the smoke harness on Monday and share results by Tue morning.
- One ask: can Redwood extend the compatibility shim fallback window to 45 days for Cobalt Tech? Our release cadence is slightly slower and the extra buffer helps QA. If you can approve that, we can commit to enabling v3 on prod no earlier than 2028-08-01.

If that sounds ok, I will reply-all with the repo link and jia's contact.

Claire
